no_exit_wounds.title: No Exit Wounds
no_exit_wounds.stable: Each cultist: single cranial entry, no exit, no powder burns. The bullet arrived; it did not travel.
drift: Entry wounds present as coin-pressed wax. Exit absent as if never owed.
The skulls refuse the second hole the profession requires.

no_powder.title: No Powder Burns
no_powder.stable: Collars unscorched. Distance or something that never needed a barrel.
drift: No powder. No scorch. As if the holes were requested.

sixth_unknown.title: Unknown Male
sixth_unknown.stable: Sixth body: ~50–60, club dress, watch stopped 3:17, maker filed smooth. No name in membership rolls.
drift: The sixth declines every category: victim, suspect, witness, name.
UNKNOWN MALE — a blank that holds the file open.

mother_son.title: Woman and Boy
mother_son.stable: Unidentified female and male minor, colored, presumed related. Not destitute. Packed for elsewhere.
drift: Mother and son — easiest to disappear, hardest to unwrite once written as eight.
Their clothes expected another town.

transients_lie.title: "Transients"
transients_lie.stable: Official convenience. Closes doors: no address, no employer, no wire. Your file still says eight.
drift: Transients — a word that files absence as conclusion.
The town's preferred silence has a name.

eight_not_six.title: Eight, Not Six
eight_not_six.stable: Odell: six members. You: eight people. Your hand wrote EIGHT large.
drift: Six is the report. Eight is the truth the file keeps.

odell_pressure.title: Odell's Shape
odell_pressure.stable: Captain wants a shape that holds: six respectable men, gas-adjacent silence. Not eight.
drift: He took the pencil. He did not cross anything out. That was worse.

official_six.title: Official Count: Six
official_six.stable: Department framing: six club members. The woman and boy are a filing matter.
drift: Six members are dead. The other two are paperwork.

behan_declined.title: Behan Declined
behan_declined.stable: Father Behan invited twice to sit with them; declined twice.
drift: A priest knows when a table is set for something other than supper.

fenn_burial.title: Fenn's Burial Wish
fenn_burial.stable: Dr. Fenn insisted twice on burial beside the club, not his wife. Parish record confirms.
drift: FENN DID NOT FEAR DEATH. HE FEARED BEING LEFT BEHIND.
Beside the club — as if proximity were a kind of homecoming.

they_spoke_of_her.title: They Spoke of Her
they_spoke_of_her.stable: Toward the end the six stopped speaking of power. They spoke tenderly of a maternal figure who would have them home.
drift: SHE'LL HAVE US HOME. SHE'S NO DIFFERENT FROM ANY MOTHER.
Benevolent maternal power — the shape they sought.

kessler_parcel.title: Kessler's Parcel
kessler_parcel.stable: Kessler carried a butcher-paper parcel into a private room; left without it. Ledger notes CLUB — PARCEL on a last-Thursday.
drift: What the butcher brought was not meat.

kessler_used.title: Kessler Used
kessler_used.stable: Shop money bought a chair among men who called him tradesman and less behind his back.
drift: Used and despised in the same evening.

kessler_knife.title: Boning Knife
kessler_knife.stable: Kessler's knife, wiped clean, under hedge root. Bagged and tagged.
drift: Too clean for a butcher's honest night.

monthly_meetings.title: Last Thursdays
monthly_meetings.stable: Six men met last Thursday of every month for over two years.
drift: A calendar of devotion disguised as club night.

sixth_unseen.title: The Sixth Never Signed
sixth_unseen.stable: Sixth never signed a bill, never arrived by front door, absent from membership rolls.
drift: A chair remembers weight. The rolls do not remember him.

maternal_power.title: Maternal Power
maternal_power.stable: Cult sought benevolent maternal power — home, not dominion. Kessler: She's no different from any mother.
drift: Not a throne. A return. That is what they asked for.
Constance — the name the distortion will learn later.

observers_refuse.title: Estate Crew Refuse
observers_refuse.stable: Groundsmen at the tunnel mouth: flat refusal. Ground is wrong. Curiosity is not their duty.
drift: They do not go down. They are correct.

redundant_evidence.title: Second Notebook
redundant_evidence.stable: Private notebook redundant to the board. Presentation may drift; underlying facts recoverable.
drift: Trust paper more than the hand that wrote it.

links.title: Six Seeking Her
links.text: Not a conspiracy of power. A conspiracy of return — six elites asking a maternal force to take them home.

links.title: Who Gets Counted
links.text: The woman and boy were easiest to disappear. Official six. Your eight. The town's silence has a body count.

links.title: Not a Shooting
links.text: Wounds without travel. Knife wiped clean. Whatever killed them did not need the tools of men — or used men as the tool.

links.title: The Load-Bearing Blank
links.text: Some blanks in a case file are not oversights. The unnamed sixth is load-bearing.
